findings.obligation: test-writing skill frontend checklist item 2 and rule 1: a wording rule is asserted on a function, not through a render; P5 pins the visible text through the grid
findings.observation: Verbatim: noMatchMessage: (text) => `No ${featuresTerm} match "${text}".`. The wording is an inline arrow in the component body, not exported, so only test 1 of searchEdges reaches it, through a full MUI render. Non-blocking: the render-level assertion is the public observation P5 requires, so the oracle is not weakened. Severity: low.
findings.remediation: Non-blocking. When this slice's wording is next touched, move the wording to a named exported pure function beside the term owner and let the acceptance designer decide whether a function-level check joins the oracle; the render check stays.

observations.text: Commit c8f0e3b18 (HEAD). Declared verification argv: pnpm --dir Lighthouse.Frontend exec cross-env TZ=Europe/Zurich vitest run --reporter=json src/components/Common/FeatureListDataGrid/FeatureListDataGrid.searchEdges.test.tsx. exit=0. stdout: JSON report written to Lighthouse.Frontend/test-results.json. stderr: empty. Result: 4 of 4 passed (says no Feature matches; keeps empty-list message; lists only both-filter rows; first page on new search from page 2). Single-run durations s: 0.874, 0.105, 1.048, 1.726.

Touched-file selector, S2 product and oracle files: argv: pnpm exec cross-env TZ=Europe/Zurich vitest related --run src/components/Common/DataGrid/DataGridBase.tsx src/components/Common/DataGrid/types.ts src/components/Common/FeatureListDataGrid/FeatureListDataGrid.tsx src/components/Common/FeatureListDataGrid/FeatureListDataGrid.searchEdges.test.tsx (cwd Lighthouse.Frontend). Selected 142 files, 2292 tests. Result: Test Files 7 failed | 135 passed; Tests 7 failed | 2285 passed; exit not captured (run backgrounded, output file only). Failing: ReportsPage.listedOnce (5000 ms timeout), PortfolioDetailAccessTab, organizationTabs, TeamDetailAccessTab, ReportsPrintPage, DeliverySection.overdue, DeliverySourceTab.whyAndSearch. Run concurrently with another session's uncommitted S3 edits and under parallel load; no S2 file is imported by these failing tests' S2 path.

Re-run of the 7 failing files alone, argv: pnpm exec cross-env TZ=Europe/Zurich vitest run --reporter=dot <7 file paths>. exit=0. stdout: Test Files 7 passed (7); Tests 61 passed (61). stderr: SignalR connection noise only. Conclusion: the broad-run failures are load-dependent (timeout and text lookup), not S2 defects; attribution is an inference from isolated green, not a proof of flakiness.

Timing, 9 sequential runs of FeatureListDataGrid.searchEdges.test.tsx, per-test seconds (vitest json): test1 median 0.856 max 1.319; test2 median 0.095 max 0.166; test3 median 1.020 max 1.198; test4 'opens the first page...' median 1.847 max 2.109. Budget .test.tsx 2 s (vitest.config.ts BUDGET_SECONDS). Runs over budget: 1 of 9 (test4, 2.109 s). Not two or more, so no budget finding; test4 sits at 92 pct of budget and test3 above half budget.

Test-writing rule 9 (deliberate break proof) not evidenced by the candidate and not run by reviewer (reviewer does not edit files). Reasoned, not measured: removing the noResultsOverlayLabel spread or the AND-filter would fail tests 1 and 3; keeping page 2 would fail test 4 (footer 51-51 of 51).

diagnostic: S2 accepted at c8f0e3b18. Declared 4 of 4 pass (R1). Selector 142 files: 7 failed in the loaded broad run, all 7 pass alone (61/61, R3); attributed to load, inference. Timing 9 runs: 1 of 9 over the 2 s budget (test4 2.109 s, median 1.847 s), no budget finding (R4). Oracle covers P5, P7, P8 and the empty-list message; acceptance names match the test titles. One non-blocking finding (implementation, low): wording inline in FeatureListDataGrid.tsx:159, asserted through render. Rule 9 deliberate-break not evidenced by candidate (R5, not measured).
